title: Police cleared in in-cell death
article: Temiskaming Shores Police have been cleared of any wrong-doing in the death of a man while in police custody.

In July, Ontario's Special Investigation Unit (SIU) completed its investigation into the death of 31-year-old Arvo Marttila who died on Tuesday March 27th while in custody at the Temiskaming Shores Police station.
Toxicological tests showed Arvo Marttila, 31, had lethal levels of a prescribed drug in his body.
SIU looked into the death, a standard procedure whenever a person dies in police custody.
